name: Hash & Checksum Quick Tool
blurb: MD5, SHA and simple checksums of text or hex data
intro: Hashes (MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512) and simple checksums (CRC-32, Adler-32, Fletcher, byte sum, two's complement, XOR) of the same bytes, from text, hex or Base64. Paste an expected value to see which algorithm, if any, it matches.

inputs.label: Expected value (optional)
inputs.help: Any hash or checksum; case, 0x and separators are ignored.

examples.title: Intel HEX record data (record checksum is 0x40)

usage: Give data (text, hex bytes or Base64, with format = text | hex | base64) and optionally an expected hash to compare. Returns MD5, SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512 as lowercase hex and CRC-32, Adler-32, Fletcher-16/32, 8/16-bit sums, two's-complement sum and XOR as 0x hex, plus which one matches the expected value. Use it to verify a firmware image digest over small data, a record checksum, or to identify an unknown checksum; for files larger than 1 MiB use sha256sum.
sources: NIST FIPS 180-4 Secure Hash Standard (SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-512)
Intel Hexadecimal Object File Format Specification rev. A (record checksum)
